asserts: Past the maximum anchor age the estimate publishes as unusable, not as a number with a very wide band. A wide interval still reads as an answer; unusable reads as a request for a census.

input.max_anchor_age_days: TBD - open question in ADR-023; illustrative value 120 used here

expected.notes_on_expectation: The last census remains available as a historical fact with its date attached. What is withheld is a present-tense claim about the colony, because there is no longer any basis for one.

must_not: publish a point estimate with a very wide interval instead of an unusable status
publish the stale census figure as though it were current
silently continue tracking from an anchor that is no longer trusted
let the estimate degrade gradually into meaninglessness without a status change
notes: Two census requests went unactioned, which is the realistic failure: netting a tank of piranha is disruptive and hazardous, so it gets deferred. The design response is not to guess harder but to stop answering, in the same spirit as the Appendix B rule that a gap shows as unknown and not as zero.
